suggestions: Add explicit SAFE-T framework (Specific plan, Access to means, Feelings, Earlier attempts, Threat) to all suicide risk MCQs

Replace 'Unknown' references with actual Australian sources (eTG Psychiatry, RANZCP guidelines, Therapeutic Guidelines)
Add Aboriginal/TSI cultural safety considerations to at least 10% of psychiatry MCQs
Standardize Mental Health Act references to specific state legislation (NSW MHA 2007, VIC MHA 2014, QLD MHA 2016)
Remove brand names (Suboxone, Seroquel, Zyprexa) - use generic names only
Differentiate key_points sections for each subtopic - avoid template duplication
Add C-SSRS (Columbia Suicide Severity Rating Scale) explicit framework to suicide risk MCQs
Include CIWA-Ar score monitoring in alcohol withdrawal MCQs
Add lithium therapeutic range (0.6-1.0 mmol/L) to bipolar disorder MCQs
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of psychiatry topics: Depression, Anxiety, Bipolar, Psychosis, Suicide Risk, Substance Use

Mental Health Act involuntary criteria correctly stated in multiple MCQs (4 criteria: mental illness, risk, treatment needed, no alternative)

agent_evaluations.reviewer_notes: Dataset contains mix of high-quality original MCQs (PSY-DEP-20260125-* through PSY-FINAL-20260125-*) with proper RAG citations, and lower-quality template-generated MCQs (PSY-ANX-BIP-20260125-2000+) with zero RAG confidence. Original 30 MCQs are acceptable for deployment. Recommend EXCLUDING template-generated MCQs (IDs 2000-2064) until RAG citations added. Critical safety content (suicide risk, Mental Health Act, clozapine monitoring) is clinically accurate but needs SAFE-T framework explicitly stated. Aboriginal/TSI cultural safety is completely absent - add to ≥10% of MCQs before production deployment.
